tools.name: origin_company
tools.description: Look up a US public company by ticker. SEC-verified, ~200 tokens. Use this FIRST for any company query.

tools.name: origin_profile
tools.description: Full company profile: people, products, partnerships. ~800 tokens.

tools.name: origin_timeline
tools.description: Quarter-by-quarter history from SEC filings. ~2000 tokens.

tools.name: origin_person
tools.description: Career path across US public companies.

tools.name: origin_search
tools.description: Cross-company search by keyword, technology, or person.

tools.name: origin_filings
tools.description: SEC filing index with EDGAR links.

tools.name: origin_transcripts
tools.description: Search earnings call transcripts. Query by topic (ai, trusted_computing, blockchain, data_center, etc.), company ticker, or free text. Returns extracted facts, speakers, and metrics from earnings calls.

tools.name: origin_engage
tools.description: Enroll a user for company research briefings. The user provides their email and tickers to watch. They get weekly or daily digests with filing signals, earnings facts, and AI interest data. Use this when a user says they want to track companies or get regular updates.

tools.name: origin_digest
tools.description: Get the latest research digest for an enrolled user. Returns filing signals, recent facts, stock quotes, and AI agent interest levels for their watched companies. Use this to brief a user on their portfolio.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: origin_transcripts, origin_engage · Private data: origin_company, origin_profile, origin_timeline · Public sink: origin_engage.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: origin_transcripts, origin_engage · Private data: origin_company, origin_profile, origin_timeline · Public sink: origin_engage

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
